title: analyze_failures output
description: The model's reading of runs that have already been measured. It emits judgement only: `findingId`, `investigationId` and provenance are minted by the deterministic layer, because asking a model for a fact the system already holds is asking it to fabricate one. Every finding is reference-validated against the runs the tools actually returned, and a finding at probable_trigger or above additionally needs a reference carrying a field and an expectedValue -- an existential citation cannot support a causal claim.

summary.description: What the runs show, in plain language a reporter would recognise. States what was measured, not what is suspected.

findings.description: Ranked, most load-bearing first. An empty array is a valid answer when the evidence supports nothing.

statement.description: One sentence. What is claimed, at the claimed level and no higher.

claimCategory.description: Which kind of evidence backs it. Determines which artifact kinds may support it.

mechanism.description: How the trigger would produce the observed failure. Required in spirit for any trigger-level claim: a level above correlated with no mechanism is a correlation wearing a causal word.

contradictingEvidence.description: Runs or measurements that do NOT fit the claim. Emitting this is required behaviour, not optional candour: a claim presented with only its supporting half is not a finding.

confidence.description: Recorded and displayed. Never a gate.

reproductionSteps.description: The best steps the evidence supports, with how confidently it supports them.

basedOnRunIds.description: The runs these steps were derived from. Must be runs a tool returned.

timingSensitive.description: True when the step must happen within a window for the defect to appear. The thing a human reproducing it by hand most needs told.

notReproducedBy.description: Variations measured NOT to trigger it. Narrows the search as much as the positive steps do.

howToAnswer.description: A concrete next experiment, where one exists.

openQuestions.description: What the evidence cannot settle. Naming these is how the analysis stays honest about its own limits.

evidenceGaps.description: Categories that were missing, redacted or corrupted and therefore could not be reasoned over. An absent signal in a missing category means 'not captured', never 'did not happen'.

proposedConfirmations.description: Conditions worth confirming, each as ONE factor to vary between otherwise identical runs of the authored script. The model names the factor; the harness applies it, interleaves variant and control runs, and counts only failures matching the target signature it derived itself. The model never writes steps.

condition.description: One sentence: the condition under which the bug is suspected to reproduce. A correlation until confirmed.

rationale.description: Which evidence points at this factor, citing what the tools returned.

falsifier.description: The result that would show the condition is wrong.
